notes: Shelf rebuilt from 3 old kinds (k77 Manchego, k79 Torta cheese, k83 Cotija) into 9 kinds with 32 archetypes; every archetype source was retrieved this session (Wikipedia en/pt pages, the DGADR Portuguese traditional products register, Center of Portugal for Rabaçal). Dropped from old Manchego m: 'Käse Manchego' (Käse Fromagerie) and 'Begum Victoria Manchego' (not traceable to a Spanish PDO producer), 'Queso Manchego PDO' (generic duplicate of the archetype), 'Marantona semicurado' (La Casota) and 'Queso de oveja añejo al romero' (Vega Sotuélamos), which are not labelled Manchego PDO. Remaining old producer models became versions of Queso Manchego PDO; I could not verify them further because the search limit was hit. Dropped from old Torta m: 'Bombón Sudao' (Rufino) and 'Queijo de Ovelha Amanteigado' (Quinta do Pomar), both of unclear designation. The generic PDO entries became archetypes (Serra da Estrela, Torta del Casar, La Serena, Azeitão, Serpa). The non-PDO tortas Torta del Zújar and Torta de Barros stay in m. Old kind sources for Torta (Repsol shop) and Cotija (news article) were replaced with Wikipedia pages. No brand-register entries: all archetypes are maker-free protected-origin or regional types, and the producer pages were not retrieved. Not done: Mahón curing grades (tierno/semicurado/curado/añejo) and Manchego producer histories, which lack retrieved sources; Queijo de Nisa, Évora, Serpa and Terrincho have PDO pages, but the Rabaçal Wikidata entity was not reachable, so a regional tourism page was used. The wiki and wikidata helper tools failed (lock error, HTTP 429), so pages were retrieved with web_fetch. No moves out of this shelf.
